description:
Everything you need for Abhi & Alisha's wedding week in Cancún — in one beautiful place, and it works offline, so you're never without the details.

THE SCHEDULE
Every celebration from the Haldi morning to the last dance: times, places, dress codes, and what's happening now. Add the whole week to your calendar in one tap, and let Live Activities keep the current celebration on your Lock Screen.

YOUR OUTFITS
Each celebration suggests what to wear. Build your own look, photo by photo, and see it beside the schedule.

RSVP
Find your invitation with your name, respond for your whole family, and change your answers any time.

WEDDING WEEK PHOTOS
Follow the celebrations as they happen. Abhi & Alisha add photographs throughout the week — swipe through, zoom in, and save the ones you love.

STAY IN TOUCH
Announcements from the couple arrive as notifications and live in a deck of keepsake cards. Ask a question to every guest, or stay close to family in your own chat.

MY EXPERIENCE
The resort map, the wing your room is in, shuttles, travel days, and answers to every question guests ask.

See you in Cancún.
promotionalText: Your invitation to every celebration — the schedule, your outfits, RSVP, family chat, and Wedding Week photos as they happen, on and offline.
